# FDG3038

> DO name classes and structs with nouns or noun phrases, using PascalCasing.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 3.5 Names of Classes, Structs, and Interfaces.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: verified

## From the book

This distinguishes type names from methods, which are named with verb phrases.
